decisions.statement: An apply naming no change lands the edits already kept.
The arguments a change takes are piped in.
An argument is a line `key: value` or `key <fence>` opening a body `<fence>` alone closes.
An apply naming a change answers that change before landing.
An apply naming a change measures that landing where `measure` says so.
An apply lands every edit kept rather than the edits that run answered.
The key `draft` is refused.
The value at `message` says what the commit is for.
An apply naming no message composes the message.
A change that refuses lands nothing.
The checks judge the whole set of edits kept.
A check refusing leaves every edit kept where those edits are.
Why the apply refused is written beside the calling agent's page.
A word naming an act over the edits kept is read here as a change to answer.
An agent whose page is nowhere is refused rather than answered with nothing.
No flag other than the help flag is said on the command line.
The help flag is answered with what an apply does and what an apply takes.
The help flag is read before the arguments are, so nothing need be piped in.
`break-the-glass` passes the checks.
The value at `break-the-glass` is why no check is to run.
The key `measure` runs the checks and lands nothing.
A measuring apply holds no test file to a ceiling.
A measuring apply is allowed more seconds than this page states.
A measuring apply says what each test file the change names spent.
An apply naming no measure lands only where every test file is under the ceiling.
A measuring apply with no test file refuses rather than landing.
What one apply run cost is appended beside this page.
An apply a change reached is recorded as a run of its own.
An apply's time tracks the test files beside the batch rather than the pages in it.
A landing may wrap a line the change wrote.
What lands is not always the text handed in.
An apply is ended at the ceiling on the wall clock its page states.
An apply ended that way lands nothing and says nothing.
A change past the processor seconds its page allows lands nothing.

definition: the command landing every edit kept, answering one change first where one is named
